loyalty.ai-journey-force.title: Why AI? A journey doesn't move itself
loyalty.ai-journey-force.description: Why AI decisioning matters: features are the journey stages; without a force between them members stay at rest (Newton's first law). AI as the connecting layer, not an analysis layer on top.

baseProps.heading: Why AI? A journey doesn't move itself
baseProps.quote: Every body persists in its state of rest unless it is compelled to change by forces impressed upon it.
baseProps.portraitAlt: Isaac Newton, portrait by Godfrey Kneller, 1689
body: Loyalty works the same way. The features are the stages. Left alone, a member stops at the last one they reached.
AI decisioning is the force between stages: for each member, the right push at the right moment.

baseProps.heading: Agent Operating Procedures
baseProps.description: Define how AI and human agents handle each intent — steps, allowed tools, escalation, and required checks.

details.title: Approved runbooks
details.description: Keep product questions, complaints, exchanges, refunds, and edge cases on brand-approved paths.

details.title: Shared by AI and humans
details.description: The same Agent Operating Procedures guide AI replies and agent desktop work.

details.title: Escalation rules
details.description: Hand off with context when a case needs judgment, tools, or a specialist queue.

baseProps.heading: Case Log & Review

details.title: Playback + transcript
details.description: Open the recording and transcript without leaving the customer and ticket context.

details.title: QA-ready evidence
details.description: Scores, notes, and follow-ups attach to the case so coaching starts from the real interaction.

baseProps.headline:
Omnichannel
Connectivity
featureDescription: Connect chat-shaped channels and voice numbers into one operating queue without losing each platform's native settings.
Channel adapters preserve webhook health, sessions, threading, credentials, and platform identity while sharing the same conversation layer.

baseProps.heading: Workflow & Routing
baseProps.description: Route and reply with deterministic workflows before AI or a human agent is needed — keyword switches, assignment, tags, and chatbot steps in one graph.

details.title: Intent switches
details.description: Match keywords or intents to branch a conversation into the right bot, queue, or team.

details.title: Routing actions
details.description: Assign, prioritize, flag, escalate, or send a reply without waiting on agent judgment.

details.title: AI handoff when needed
details.description: When the case needs reasoning, the flow can invoke CS AI with customer, channel, and history intact.

baseProps.heading: Integrated Inbox
baseProps.description: Give agents one workspace for every channel, customer profile, and AI-assisted reply — the same desktop that sits beside voice.

details.title: One agent desktop
details.description: Conversations, notes, priority, assignment, and customer memory sit in a single screen.

details.title: Full context
details.description: Summaries, knowledge, and suggested replies stay attached to the customer.

details.title: Cross-channel continuity
details.description: Agents pick up the thread whether the member wrote in chat, LINE, or another connected channel.

baseProps.headline: IVR Flows
featureDescription: Route callers before an AI voice agent or human picks up, using keypad input, speech recognition, language selection, and business hours.
Flows can send callers to queues, callbacks, voicemail, AI self-service, or human transfer with intent and context carried forward.

baseProps.heading: Knowledge Base
baseProps.description: Make AI and human replies come from brand-approved facts, not model memory or tribal knowledge.

details.title: Grounding layer
details.description: Articles, synced sources, and Custom Answers define what support can say.

details.title: Citations & scope
details.description: Language, scope, and source health control what is eligible for each reply.

details.title: Shared by AI and agents
details.description: The same knowledge powers AI answers and the agent desktop assist.

baseProps.headline: Tickets & SLA
featureDescription: Turn conversations or internal requests into structured work with owners, clocks, fields, status, and approval paths.
Ticket types, custom fields, relationships, SLAs, priorities, cross-team handoffs, and conversation links keep complex cases moving.

baseProps.headline: Voice Console
featureDescription: Handle inbound and outbound calls in the same customer service layer as chat, AI, and actions.
Live transcript, recording, customer profile, prior conversations, warm transfer, disposition, and follow-up save back to the customer record.

baseProps.headline: Watchtower Audit
featureDescription: Monitor whether humans, rules, and AI are resolving service work correctly across the same event stream.
Watchtower surfaces hallucination risk, off-brand replies, low-CSAT predictions, SLA pressure, tool failures, and knowledge gaps for tuning.

baseProps.heading: Supervisor Agent
baseProps.description: Configure how the Supervisor Agent scores resolved cases — criteria, weights, and coaching focus for chat and voice.

details.title: Evaluation criteria
details.description: Set what good looks like: procedure adherence, tone, helpfulness, and resolution quality.

details.title: Sampling rules
details.description: Choose which cases the agent reviews so QA covers the queues that matter.

details.title: Coaching outputs
details.description: Turn scores into suggested coaching notes agents and leads can act on.

baseProps.heading: Supervisor Case Evaluation
baseProps.description: Open a resolved case and see the Supervisor Agent scorecard beside the transcript — evidence linked to each criterion.

details.title: Score with evidence
details.description: Each criterion shows a score and a jump link into the matching moment in the transcript.

details.title: Chat and voice
details.description: The same evaluation surface covers messaging cases and call recordings.

details.title: Actionable coaching
details.description: Suggested coaching sits next to the score so review leads to a concrete next step.

baseProps.heading: CS Analytics
baseProps.description: See how support is performing across channels, queues, agents, and AI — volume, resolution, SLA, and quality in one view.

details.title: Operational KPIs
details.description: Track volume, handle time, resolution rate, and backlog by channel and queue.

details.title: Quality signals
details.description: Surface supervisor scores, CSAT, and review coverage alongside throughput.

details.title: Tuning focus
details.description: Spot where workflows, AI, or staffing need attention before issues compound.

baseProps.heading: AI Analysis
baseProps.description: Ask the CRM a question in chat and get analysis plus campaign recommendations you can apply as drafts — without exporting data for manual work.

details.title: Ask in plain language
details.description: Query membership, campaigns, and loyalty performance the way a marketer thinks — not as SQL.

details.title: Evidence-backed answers
details.description: Responses use live CRM context instead of a disconnected spreadsheet export.

details.title: Draft campaigns
details.description: Turn recommendations into campaign drafts you can review and apply from the same flow.

baseProps.heading: Audience Builder
baseProps.description: Define who should enter a journey before the campaign spends budget.

details.title: Rich segment rules
details.description: Combine profile, behavior, wallet, tier, and workflow context in one definition.

details.title: Reusable audiences
details.description: Use the same segment across journeys, campaigns, and decisioning agents.

details.title: Spend with intent
details.description: Stop blanket campaigns — only the members who match enter the flow.

baseProps.heading: AI Decisioning Agent
baseProps.description: Give AI a goal and guardrails, then let it choose Act, Wait, or Skip for each member.

details.title: Act / Wait / Skip
details.description: The agent evaluates fresh context before intervening — not every member gets a message.

details.title: Guardrails
details.description: Budget, cooldowns, quiet hours, blackout dates, and allowed actions keep decisions inside brand limits.

details.title: Reusable in journeys
details.description: Drop the same agent into workflows wherever high-judgment decisions are needed.

baseProps.heading: Journey Builder
baseProps.description: Turn customer behavior into always-on journeys that react without manual campaign lists.

details.title: Workflow graph
details.description: Combine triggers, branches, waits, messages, loyalty actions, audience changes, and API calls.

details.title: AI agent nodes
details.description: Hand high-judgment steps to an AI Decisioning Agent inside the same journey.

details.title: Decision logs
details.description: Every path stays auditable so marketers can tune the next version with evidence.
